aarti.tek: Om, victory to you, Hari, Lord of the universe; victory to you, Master! In a moment you take away the troubles of your devotees and servants.
aarti.pad1: Whoever meditates on you gains the fruit, and the sorrow of his mind is destroyed. Happiness and wealth come to his home, and the suffering of his body ends.
aarti.pad2: You are my mother and father; whose refuge should I seek? Without you there is no other in whom I could place my hope.
aarti.pad3: You are the complete Supreme Self, the one who dwells within all. You are the Supreme Brahman, the Supreme Lord, the master of all.
aarti.pad4: You are an ocean of compassion, the sustainer of all. I am a fool who longs for rewards; I am the servant and you the master. Have mercy, O provider.
aarti.pad5: You are the One, beyond the reach of the senses, the lord of every life. By what means, O merciful one, can I, so dull of mind, reach you?
aarti.pad6: Friend of the lowly, remover of sorrow, you are my Lord and my protector. Raise your hand in blessing, take me into your refuge; I lie at your door.
aarti.pad7: Wipe away the disorders born of the senses, take away my sins, O God. Increase my faith and devotion, and my service to the saints.
